sayLines: A woman, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A person, maybe 60s, with weathered hands heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 60s sets out to find A woman, maybe 20s, with a farmer's tan. "Won't be long."
A man, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 20s, with tattooed arms sets out to find A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose. "Won't be long."
A woman, maybe 40s heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
💬 A person, maybe 50s is with A man, maybe 40s, with a limp, talking the way people do when nobody else is listening.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Molt**. It resonates with: something unnamed.
